messages.subject: Problem with screenreg
parts:
Had problems with CFA example in Hallquist & Wiley (2018) when running screenreg. See  below.

Thanks

runModels("cfa_example.inp")
> cfares <- MplusAutomation::readModels("cfa_example.out")
> View(cfares)
> screenreg(cfares, cis = TRUE, single.row = TRUE,+ summaries = c('BIC', 'CFI', 'SRMR'))
